description: Calming breath pattern: inhale 4s, hold 7s, exhale 8s. A good first technique — the longer exhale settles the nervous system.
name: 4-7-8 Breathing

phases.instruction: Breathe in quietly through your nose for 4 counts.
phases.label: Inhale

phases.instruction: Hold your breath for 7 counts, keeping your body soft.
phases.label: Hold

phases.instruction: Exhale slowly through your mouth for 8 counts, fully emptying your lungs.
phases.label: Exhale
